Hon'ble Shri Deepak Kumar Tiwari, J Order On Board 20/02/2023 :

1. The present petition has been preferred by the petitioners seeking to quash the FIR No.408/2019, registered at Police Station Purani Bhilai, District Durg for offence under Section 420 read with Section 34 of the IPC.

2. Facts of the case are that petitioner No.1 had entered into an agreement for obtaining lease of agricultural land of respondent No.2 situated at village Ghughuwa,
Tehsil Patan, District Durg.

It is alleged that on account of some dispute, respondent Balkrishna Sharma vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37251090/
1 No.2 has filed a complaint before the PS Purani Bhilai, District Durg for offence under Section 420/34 of the IPC.

entities.text: Balkrishna Sharma vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that both the parties have settled their dispute amicably by way of compromise.

4. The Additional Registrar (Judicial) of this Court has recorded the statement of the parties in which they have categorically supported the aforesaid compromise which was arrived on their own free will, without any undue influence, coercion or inducement.
So, further continuation of the criminal proceeding would not serve any purpose.

5. It is well settled that the High Court in exercise of its inherent powers can quash criminal proceedings or FIR or complaint and Section 320 of the Code does not limit or affect the powers under Sections 482 of the Code.

{See : B.S. Joshi and Others Vs.
State of Haryana and Another, (2003) 4 SCC 675}.
6. In view of the above, the Petition is allowed and the criminal proceeding flowing from FIR No.408/2019 registered at Police Station Purani Bhilai, District Durg for offence under Section 420/34 of the IPC is hereby quashed.
Sd/-
